title: Ukrainian border guards on Snake Island refuse Russian warship's surrender demand
body:
On 24 February 2022, the first day of the full-scale Russian invasion, 13 Ukrainian border guards were stationed on Snake Island (Zmiinyi), a small rocky island in the Black Sea. A Russian warship approached the island and demanded that the garrison surrender. The ship's message, as reported, proposed that the guards lay down their arms and surrender to avoid bloodshed and unnecessary victims.

The guards refused, replying in a radio exchange that was recorded and widely circulated: "Russian warship, go fuck yourself." The guards were then threatened with bombing. According to a report by Ukrainska Pravda cited by Military Times, Russian forces fired on the island from the ship and then struck it with combat aircraft. Contact with the guards was lost that evening.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky initially said the guards had died defending the island. The Ukrainian Navy later reported that they were alive and held as Russian prisoners. The reply became a widely used rallying cry, and the phrase spread across social media during the first days of the war. Snake Island lies off the coast near Odesa and is positioned to influence shipping lanes in the north-western Black Sea.
